caption: The first element in enumeration order
The first $n$ past $2^{53}$ for parts of size at most $5$: the count is the pentanacci-style recurrence, exact as a big integer
Far past $2^{53}$ the count stays exact: the coefficient of $x^{100}$ in $1/(1 - x - \cdots - x^{10})$
No part fits, so no composition of a positive $n$
